Picture: Gudbrand strolls happily along a dusty valley road in the golden late-afternoon light, a cinnamon-brown rooster tucked under one arm and his pipe in the corner of his mouth, looking as pleased as a man who has made the best bargain in the world. Far up on the steep hillside above him, the Hillside Farm waits in the sun among yellow birches.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- Gudbrand: A short, round, easy-going farmer of about sixty with a round belly, a shiny bald head, fluffy white side-whiskers from his ears down to his jaw, a clean-shaven chin, a big pink nose, small merry blue eyes and a calm, contented smile. He wears a soft dark-green felt hat with a narrow brim, a thick knitted jacket with a black-and-white snowflake pattern and pewter clasps, brown breeches, grey wool stockings and heavy boots, and always has a short curved wooden pipe.

Setting:
- the Hillside Farm: A tiny farm high on a steep hillside: a low, dark-brown log cottage with a thick turf roof growing grass and wild flowers, a stone chimney, two small four-paned windows and a sturdy plank door painted dusky blue, with a little cowshed beside it. A birch and a rowan tree heavy with red berries stand in the yard, and a narrow path zigzags steeply down towards the valley and a small town far below.

Story world: Old rural Norway, in a deep mountain valley. Gudbrand's small farm lies high up on a steep hillside, and a narrow path zigzags down past the neighbour's farm to the valley road and a small market town far below. Inside the cottage is one warm room with a fireplace, a long table with benches, a painted cupboard and a big wooden chest. Gudbrand and his wife have three children: a boy of about twelve with short black hair and a green jumper, a girl of about nine with two stubby fair plaits and a red dress, and a small boy of about six in a long white shirt. The animals: a black cow with a white face, a sandy-yellow fjord horse with a striped pale mane, a fat pink pig, a white nanny goat, a woolly white sheep, a big white goose and a cinnamon-brown rooster.

This story's season, light and colours: A warm, dusty late-September day in the valley: hazy golden air, yellowing birches, rowans heavy with red berries, grey dust on the road and on everything along it, low amber sun and long violet shadows in the afternoon. Then a clear, cool night with a big orange harvest moon over the mountains. Inside the cottage: warm firelight and candlelight on honey-brown timber. Accents: the wife’s cornflower-blue apron and rowan red.

characters.name: Gudbrand-on-the-Slope
characters.description: A well-meaning farmer who cheerfully trades his way home and trusts that his wife will see the good in it.
characters.look: A short, round, easy-going farmer of about sixty with a round belly, a shiny bald head, fluffy white side-whiskers from his ears down to his jaw, a clean-shaven chin, a big pink nose, small merry blue eyes and a calm, contented smile. He wears a soft dark-green felt hat with a narrow brim, a thick knitted jacket with a black-and-white snowflake pattern and pewter clasps, brown breeches, grey wool stockings and heavy boots, and always has a short curved wooden pipe.

characters.name: Gudbrand’s Wife
characters.description: Practical and remarkably supportive, she praises each decision and turns every loss into a blessing.
characters.look: A plump, cheerful farm wife of about fifty, a little shorter than Gudbrand, with a round, beaming face, rosy cheeks, a broad, freckled nose, merry hazel eyes that crinkle when she laughs and grey hair pinned up in a neat bun. She wears a long rose-red wool dress with a white linen collar and rolled-up sleeves, a bright cornflower-blue apron tied with a big bow at the back, and a cream knitted shawl round her shoulders.

characters.name: The Neighbor
characters.description: A skeptical local farmer who wagers that Gudbrand’s wife will finally scold him—and listens outside the door to find out.
characters.look: A nosy, pot-bellied farmer of about fifty with a round, clean-shaven face, a long, pointed, twitchy nose, narrow doubtful eyes with one eyebrow always raised, big pink ears that stick straight out and short, spiky ginger hair. He wears a patched mustard-brown wool jacket with a sheepskin collar, a round brown felt hat, grey breeches and tall, scuffed boots.

places.name: the Hillside Farm
places.look: A tiny farm high on a steep hillside: a low, dark-brown log cottage with a thick turf roof growing grass and wild flowers, a stone chimney, two small four-paned windows and a sturdy plank door painted dusky blue, with a little cowshed beside it. A birch and a rowan tree heavy with red berries stand in the yard, and a narrow path zigzags steeply down towards the valley and a small town far below.

places.name: the Cottage Room
places.look: A snug, low-ceilinged log room with honey-brown timber walls. In one corner a whitewashed stone fireplace holds a crackling fire and a black iron pot. A long, scrubbed plank table with two benches stands under a small four-paned window, beside a big wooden chest with iron bands. There is a tall cupboard painted with red-and-blue rosemaling, a shelf of wooden bowls, pegs with coats and hats, and a dusky-blue plank door with an iron latch.
